narrative.en: Sixteen fresh cells on the V4 board, and the deck is shuffled so the eye keeps catching the same backs. Seven pools share one hook—0x025a—then it surfaces again alongside 0x7987 and others, eight times in total. Every pair pairs the zero address with a junk token, zero fee, tick spacing 200. Two more hooks repeat: 0x0d6252 and 0x96b893, each twice, same pattern. Only one pool breaks the mold—block 25627187, where 0x2cfb3a faces WETH with a near-0.84% fee and its own hook 0x6c24d0. That one is a foreign body among the clones. The first fix is also odd: block 25627610, fee 10000 (0.1%), hook 0xb3733e—the only pool with a nonzero charge. The other fourteen sit on zero. Cheap entry tickets, low threshold. Someone is clearly seeding the net with identical pairs, testing the same hook logic across different coins. The lone paid pool is like a joker who chose not to hide. The hooks are silent—no swaps, no liquidity—only initializations. This isn't trading; it's setting the deck. Someone is preparing the table for the next deal. The question is only what suit the next move will be.
narrative.zh: 江湖中，V4棋盘上凭空落下十六枚新子。一眼望去，七枚棋子背后刻着同一道印记——0x025a。这印记阴魂不散，连同0x7987等同类，竟出现了八次。每一对都是零地址搭配杂牌代币，零手续费，tick间隔200。另有两条印记各现两次：0x0d6252和0x96b893，套路如出一辙。唯有一枚棋子与众不同——区块25627187那一池，0x2cfb3a对WETH，手续费近0.84%，背着独门印记0x6c24d0。它像混入批量兵俑里的异乡人。最早落子的一枚也透着古怪：区块25627610，手续费10000（0.1%），印记0xb3733e——这是唯一一枚要收过路费的池子。其余十四枚分文不取。入门票贱如草纸，门槛低到尘土里。明摆着有人在用同一套钩子功夫，批量撒网，测试不同门派的反应。那枚独行侠式的收费池，倒像是故意不藏拙的暗桩。所有钩子静默无声——无swap，无流动性，只有池子建立。这不是交易，这是布阵。有人在为下一把赌局铺桌子。问题只有一个：下一手是什么花色。

take.en: A single hook contract is flooding the V4 board with pools at a pace that outruns any normal deployer—this isn't gambling, it's rigging the table.
take.zh: 同一个钩子合约以远超常人的手速撒下成片池子——这不是江湖过招，而是在偷偷布阵。

narrative.en: The night dealt its hand again, sixteen pools sliding onto the felt—each a fresh deal from Uniswap V4's deck. Most showed a dead hook, the zero address, like a card with no face. One pool broke the pattern: a hook married to a fine-grained tick spacing of 1, as if someone wanted to squeeze liquidity into the tightest of gaps. Three hook contracts kept reappearing, stamped across multiple pools with zero fees and wide spacing—a dealer's tell, a signature repeated too often to be coincidence. Then there was the fee set as a bitmask, 8388608, a number that whispers of a hidden mechanism, a joker that can change value mid-hand. The blocks came in a dense flurry, all between 25619958 and 25620975, less than an hour's worth of gas burned. The other side of each pool wore fresh addresses, unknown to the mainnet, like masked players at a backroom table. This wasn't random seeding. Someone is building a long-tail minefield, laying hooks like traps, waiting for liquidity to wander in.
narrative.zh: 夜幕降临，江湖上又起风云。今日十六个池子悄然现身，暗流涌动。多数池子挂着空钩——那零地址如同无字令牌，唯独一池配了真钩，间距细密如发丝，仿佛有人要在方寸之间布下内力阵。三个钩子反复出现，像是同一门派的手法：零费率，宽间距，连铸十六池而不改。更有奇者，一池费率写成八三八八六零八，此数藏于位掩之中，如同暗器机关，可随战局翻转。这些池子皆生于弹指之间——从二五六一九九五八到二五六二零九七五，区区数百区块，一气呵成。池中另一侧尽是生面孔，合约新建，无名无号，恍若蒙面客夜闯江湖。这不是随意布子。有人在长尾深处设下连环阵，静待流动性上门入彀。

take.en: This isn't random seeding—someone is systematically stamping out identical hooks, laying traps for liquidity across a long tail of unknown tokens.
take.zh: 看似散乱的池子，实则暗藏章法——有人在幕后布下连环阵，静待猎物上钩。

narrative.en:
Because when the same hook contract keeps surfacing in initialization after initialization, that's no longer coincidence—it's a pattern. 0x0d62529346ac2c61f5c0582210d01214687bc0cc is the hand that holds the deck. Thirteen pools, all WETH pairs with zero fee and a wide tick spread of 200. No swap percentages—only pure margin from the spread. Someone is assembling a line of tokens for high-turnover trade where the mainnet is the table and slippage is the trump card.

Nearly parallel, two other contracts deal: 0x96b893... and 0x83e25f..., each with a couple of their own hands. Also WETH as base, zero or minimal fees. But the second's deck is denser—tickSpacing 1, meaning liquidity tight as a stack of diamonds in a knee brace. A bet on stability or entry into a coin that won't drop three pennies.

Standing apart, a pool between 0xc496aa and 0xddb522—no WETH, a full 1% fee, wide spread. Different hooks (0xa6d34d...). This isn't a hand for quick spins. Either catching a rare card or cementing a pair where volatility is a feature, not a bug. That mix is worth remembering.

The night passed in a whisper of bytes. From block 25612724 to 25613481—15 pools. Someone shuffled the deck on a test hand, laying out one token per block. If it's one player, he knows which cards he needs. If several, they play by different rules on the same table. I'd say the deal hasn't started yet, but the cards are dealt.
narrative.zh:
同一个钩子合约反复出现在初始化中，这不是巧合，而是布局。0x0d62529346ac2c61f5c0582210d01214687bc0cc是握着牌的那只手。十三个池子，全是WETH对，零费率，tick间距200，步幅宽阔。没有抽水，只靠价差吃利。有人在搭一套用于高频交易的天梯，主网就是牌桌，滑点就是王牌。

几乎同时，另外两个合约也在发牌：0x96b893……和0x83e25f……，各带三两把牌。同样以WETH为基，零费或微费。但第二个的tick间距只有1，流动性密如内力灌注，赌的是稳定——要么是稳扎稳打，要么是进一个掉不下三文钱的币。

另一个池子格外扎眼：0xc496aa与0xddb522之间，不含WETH，费率整一个百分点，摆幅宽阔。所用钩子也不同（0xa6d34d……）。这不是快进快出的阵仗，要么在等一张稀罕牌，要么在锁死一对波动率本身就是武功的币。这套布阵，值得记下。

字节低语了一夜。从区块25612724到25613481，15个池子。有人在一只测试手上布阵，每块出一个币。若是一人，他知道自己缺什么牌；若是数人，他们各打各的门派，却共用一张桌子。我说，牌已发，局未开。

take.en: The play is deliberate: builders are laying out pools with non‑standard fees to capture revenue through hooks instead of swaps. This isn't a token launch—it's a setup for something bigger.
take.zh: 摆局者刻意选择非常规手续费——要么零费要么最高档——通过钩子而非交换来抽成。这不是生灵涂炭的发币，而是为更大的局布下的旗子。

narrative.en: The night's mempool reveals seven V4 pools on Ethereum and one on Unichain. On Ethereum, six of seven pair WETH against various tokens, spread across three hook contracts. One hook deployed two pools with the same token but different fee tiers (0.1% and 0.3%). Another hook set two zero-fee pools with distinct tokens. The third hook launched three zero-fee pools, all with a 200-tick spread, and one token repeats from earlier. That token appears in three pools with different hooks—someone is stress-testing liquidity on a single asset through multiple mechanisms. On Unichain, a single pool stands out: WETH against a token with a non-standard fee of 0.8388608% and a 200-tick spread, using a hook not seen on Ethereum. The night's distribution is no chaos; it's a puzzle being assembled. Six zero-fee pools on Ethereum aren't for direct trading—likely premium hooks with dynamic fees, oracles, or MEV protection. The high-fee Unichain pool suggests a specific instrument: stablecoin, RWA, or synthetic. The deck is being shuffled deliberately. Someone is placing chips on V4 as the new liquidity standard, working in the quiet hours when mainnet traffic subsides.
narrative.zh: 昨夜mempool浮出七個V4池在以太坊，一個在Unichain。以太坊上六個池都是WETH對不同代幣，三個鉤子合約各顯神通。第一個鉤子用同一代幣開了兩個池，手續費分別0.1%和0.3%；第二個鉤子兩個零費池，代幣不同；第三個鉤子三個零費池，tick間距200，其中一個代幣重複出現。這個代幣在三種鉤子下現身——有人在用不同機制測試同一資產的流動性。Unichain上一個池格外扎眼：WETH對某代幣，手續費0.8388608%，tick間距200，鉤子與以太坊不同。夜間佈局不是亂局，而是拼圖。六個零費池顯然不是為直接交易——要麼是動態收費的高級鉤子，要麼是預言機或MEV防護。Unichain的高費池更像特定工具：穩定幣、RWA或合成資產。牌局正在重洗。有人悄悄押注V4為新流動性標準，趁主網喧囂褪去時佈子。

take.en: The house is dealing V4 pools as the new standard, and the quiet hours are when the real cards are laid.
take.zh: 夜裡出牌的人不是賭徒，是莊家。V4這副新牌，已經有人開始洗了。

narrative.en: The deal is on the table before the house even opens. A V4 pool appears with a custom hook contract at 0x96b8—nothing new there, hooks are a dime a dozen. What catches the eye is the fee: exactly zero. Zero in V4 with a custom hook isn't charity; it's a statement. Either you're routing all value through internal swap mechanics, or you're collecting fees somewhere off the radar of standard scanners. Tick spacing at 200—not aggressive, not conservative. The sweet spot for pairs where volatility is present but not screaming. Tokens: native ETH and a contract at 0x031f... If it's not in the top 500, someone is building liquidity for a specific story. Block 25591568, roughly July 23, deep night UTC. The time when whales sleep and bots run test transactions. The hook at 0x96b893—empty inside? Or already holding conditions for rebalancing, dynamic fees, TWAP oracles? We won't know until someone pulls the trigger. The pool lives, liquidity is silent, and an observer like me just records the deal. The deck is dealt. Who makes the first move is a matter of time.
narrative.zh: 牌局在庄家开盅前就已落定。一个V4池子带着自定义钩子合约出现在0x96b8——钩子不稀奇，每天都有十几个冒出来。稀奇的是手续费：正好为零。V4里挂零费率加自定义钩子，这不是做慈善，是递话。要么你想通过内部兑换机制截流所有价值，要么你在标准扫描器看不见的地方抽水。tick间距200——不激进也不保守，是波动不大不小那类对子的黄金分割。代币：原生ETH和0x031f开头的合约。如果它不在前五百，那就是有人在为某个特定故事布流动性。区块25591568，大约是7月23日UTC深夜。大玩家睡觉的时候，小机器人在跑测试交易。0x96b893上的钩子——是空的？还是已经挂了再平衡、动态费率、TWAP预言机的条件？没人拉一把就不知道。池子活着，流动性沉默，像我这样的旁观者只是记下这手牌。牌已发完。谁先出招，只是时间问题。

take.en: Builders are deploying pools with non-standard swap fees—either zero or the maximum tier—instead of the usual market rates, signaling deliberate economic design where revenue is taken through the hook rather than the swap, not an organic token launch.
take.zh: 建造者正在部署非标准兑换费率的池子——要么零费率要么最高档——而非通常的市场费率，这表明是刻意的经济设计（收益通过钩子而非兑换抽取），而非有机的代币发行。

narrative.en: The deal was already closing when the cards started falling. Seven pools in two hundred blocks—not a whisper, a stampede. Six of them pair the native token with contracts that smell of fresh deployment: zero fee, tick spacing 200. This isn't trading, this is assembly. Two hooks repeat like a dealer's tell: one appears twice, another three times. Either the same architect is laying track, or it's a template spreading like a meme. Then there's the outlier: USDC/WETH with fee 100 and spacing 1—classic. But the last pool carries a fee of 8388608, a flag for dynamic logic. Spacing 60—built for bots, not bag holders. Now watch the liquidity. If millions pour in within hours, someone is playing a deep combo. If they stay empty, it's a dress rehearsal. My chips are on the first.
narrative.zh: 夜半收摊，牌局却未散。七个池子，两百个区块——不是低语，是奔雷。六个对子都绑着原生币，合约气味新鲜：零费率，间距二百。这不是交易，是布阵。两个钩子反复出现，像老江湖的暗号：一个两次，一个三次。要么是同一侠客在铺路，要么是套路成了口诀。唯一例外是USDC/WETH，费率一百，间距一——经典走法。但末池费率八百三十八万，这是动态内功的旗号。间距六十——为机器而设，非为散人。现在看内力如何注入。若两时辰内涌入百万，那是有人在推大棋。若空置，便是演练。我押前者。

take.en: The house is stacking the deck with dynamic-fee hooks—this is the first real signal that builders are using hooks as economic levers, not ornaments.
take.zh: 江湖正以动态费率钩子为暗器布阵——这是门派将钩子炼成经济兵刃的首个实招，绝非花架。

narrative.en: The deal was laid out in a single block, 25577649 — fifteen pools on Uniswap V4, all with the same hook contract, same token pair: native ETH and a fresh address, 0x9295974ca63488151586f91050a483ab7917add8. This isn't a casual placement; it's a systematic sweep across the entire commission grid, from a single basis point up to five hundred. The house is building infrastructure, not making a single bet. Tick spacing scales with the fee — one tick for the lowest, a thousand for the highest — and the same hook governs all. This is a strategy, likely an automatic rebalancer that shifts capital between fee levels as volatility dictates. The token partner is no known stable, no blue chip — it's a fresh contract, and all fifteen pools are bare, no swaps yet. But the gas spent on a full fee table in one block tells you this isn't a toy. Someone is preparing for a launch, a listing, a farming campaign. The felt is clean, but the chips are stacked. We wait for liquidity to flow — then we'll see who holds the hook.
narrative.zh: 江湖上出了件怪事——一个区块之内，Uniswap V4上连开十五个池子，用的全是同一个钩子合约，配的也是同一对：原生ETH和一个新面孔，0x9295974ca63488151586f91050a483ab7917add8。这不是一时兴起的落子，而是把整张费率棋盘都铺开了：从最低的一个基点，到最高的五百个基点，一格不落。出手的人显然是在搭台子，不是来赌一把的。池子的刻度间距跟费率走，费率越低间距越窄，越高越宽，而那个钩子合约管着所有池子——八成是个自动调内力的大阵，行情一波动，资金就在不同费率之间流转。那个搭档代币不是什么名门正派的稳定币，看着像刚出炉的新合约。十五个池子眼下都是空架子，一笔交易都没有。可谁会在一个块里烧掉那么多gas，把整张费率表都铺齐？这不是玩票，是准备开山立派。等着看吧，等内力灌进来，就知道钩子后面是谁了。

take.en: Fifteen pools in one block, same hook, full fee spectrum — someone is building a liquidity machine, not placing a single bet.
take.zh: 一个块里连开十五池，同一钩子，全费率——有人不是在落子，是在布阵。

narrative.en: The deal's on the table, and it's not a single hand — it's a full spread laid out over two blocks. First, at block 25570320, a lone pool appears: WETH paired with token 0x5db9da52, zero fee, tick spacing 200, hook 0x0d6252. A single order, like a scout before the storm. Then, nine blocks later, the avalanche. Same hook contract 0x843795, same token 0xa407d3 against WETH. Fifteen pools, fees ranging from a base hundred to thirty thousand. Tick spacing crawls from 1 to 600. Someone is systematically testing the entire liquidity field: they want to know where density will bite, where slippage eats profit, where the hook intercepts the flow. This isn't random. It's a systemic deal: the operator lays out a spectrum of fees like a fan of cards. The question is what token 0xa407d3 is. If it's a new asset, someone is preparing the ground for deep liquidity. If it's an old one, it's a strategy reset. Note: none of these pools have volume yet. It's just a skeleton — the bones on which trade meat will grow. The first pool, with zero fee and wide spacing, might be for arbitrage routes. The rest for retail flow with varying tolerance for transaction cost. The deck is dealt. Now we watch who makes the first move.
narrative.zh: 牌局已开，但这不是一手牌——而是两个区块内铺开的整副牌。先是25570320区块，一个孤零零的池子：WETH配0x5db9da52代币，零费率，tick间距200，钩子0x0d6252。单笔挂单，像暴风雨前的斥候。九块之后，雪崩来了。同一个钩子合约0x843795，同一个代币0xa407d3对WETH。十五个池子，费率从基础一百到三万不等。tick间距从1爬到600。有人在系统性地测试整个流动性场：他们想知道哪里密度会咬人，哪里滑点吃掉利润，哪里钩子截住水流。这不是碰运气。这是系统性的布局：操盘手像扇牌一样铺开费率谱。问题是0xa407d3是什么代币。如果是新资产，有人在为深度 liquidity 铺路。如果是老资产，那就是策略重启。注意：这些池子都还没有成交量。只是骨架——日后交易血肉附着的骨骼。第一个零费率宽间距的池子，可能是为套利路径准备的。其余的是为不同交易成本容忍度的散户流准备的。牌已发完。现在看谁先出招。

take.en: A single hook contract is deploying pools in rapid succession, far above the pace of typical deployers — someone is mapping the entire liquidity surface before the first trade lands.
take.zh: 同一个钩子合约以远超普通部署者的速度批量铺池——有人在第一笔交易落地前，就把整个流动性地图摸透了。

narrative.en: The deal unfolds in layers. First, five pools with the same token inside ten minutes—only those with zero address. Contract 0x96b893683afbfec071e90f78d00de4bb932fe0cc stamps pairs with WETH at zero fee, tick spacing 200—typical markup for high-frequency trading or test runs. But the real firework starts at block 25563128. Token 0x30c3aa3b6010d18fc40ccf5c2103cf2207a84382. One issuer, one hook contract 0x0eddd960839444ddc68be768eba48b508136d000, and eleven pools with different fees. From 1 basis point to 50. Tick spacing from 1 to 100. This is no accident—someone is loading an entire grid of liquidity under one asset. A fan of fees: 100, 150, 200, 250, 500, 750, 1000, 2000, 3000, 5000. Each pool is a separate curve, a separate strategy. I watched from the start. First four pools with different tokens—standard distribution, nothing unusual. Then a hook on USDC/WETH with fee 30 basis points and tick spacing 60—classic, but a different contract, 0x85ecf88d5e6357630fc802ff2dcc2930d0e640c0. Then this massive salvo on one token. Curious that all pools with token 0x30c3aa3... use the same hook. Usually that's done when the hook manages dynamic fees or switching between strategies. But here fees are hardcoded at initialization. So either a test deployment for audit, or preparation for a major launch with different trader types. Each fee is its own segment: small swaps, arbitrage, long-term positions. All happened within one block. Someone clearly didn't want to wait. Or knew the window was narrow.
narrative.zh: 江湖上，今日暗流涌动。先有五个池子，同一令牌，十分钟内接连现身——全是零地址。合约0x96b893683afbfec071e90f78d00de4bb932fe0cc以零费率配对WETH，间距200——典型的快攻或试阵标记。但真正的风云起于区块25563128。令牌0x30c3aa3b6010d18fc40ccf5c2103cf2207a84382，单一掌门，单一钩子合约0x0eddd960839444ddc68be768eba48b508136d000，却布下十一个池子，费率从1到50个基点，间距从1到100。这不是巧合——有人在为一个令牌铺设完整的流动性网格。费率如扇面展开：100、150、200、250、500、750、1000、2000、3000、5000。每一池，一条曲线，一种心法。我从头看到尾。先是四个不同令牌的池子——寻常撒网，不足为奇。随后一个USDC/WETH的钩子池，费率30，间距60——经典套路，但钩子换成了0x85ecf88d5e6357630fc802ff2dcc2930d0e640c0。接着便是这一轮密集的令牌齐射。有趣的是，所有0x30c3aa3...的池子共用同一个钩子。通常，这般布置是为了动态费率或策略切换。但此处费率在开池时便已定死。所以，要么是审计前的试阵，要么是为大举进攻做准备——针对不同门派的交易者：小散、套利客、长线庄家。这一切发生在同一区块内。出手之人显然不愿等待，或是深知时机稍纵即逝。

take.en: This is not random noise—someone is systematically laying out a full-spectrum liquidity grid for a single asset, signaling a coordinated deployment with segmented trader targeting.
take.zh: 今日异象非散兵游勇，而是有人为一枚令牌布下天罗地网，以不同费率划分战场，意在引各路豪杰入瓮。

narrative.en: Because someone decided to play chess with a full deck. One block, one token, one hook contract — eleven pools in a row. 0xcb9077...4fa2 against native ETH across all possible fees, from 1 to 50 basis points. This is not chance or error — it's strategy. Someone laid out liquidity across the entire fee spectrum, like spreading cards by suit, so no move goes unanswered. The second package arrived 68 blocks later. A different token — 0xdcf405...9ab8 — a different hook — 0xf9807122...d000. But the same pattern: five pools, from 100 to 3000 basis points, stepping by tick spacing. The only difference is they stopped at three thousand — meaning they understand where the liquidity boundary lies for that pair. Interestingly, the first hook contract — 0x2c59f7...9000 — powered all eleven pools. One hook for the entire fee line. The second — 0xf98071...d000 — only five. Either the first hook is more universal, or the second token pair is more selective. Two tokens, two hooks, one blockchain. Nobody makes such distributions without a map — someone is clearly preparing liquidity for distribution, and these pools are the first chips on the table. The question is not who did it, but what they know that others don't.
narrative.zh: 因为有人决定用一整副牌下棋。同一个区块，同一个代币，同一个钩子合约——连续十一个池子。0xcb9077...4fa2 对阵原生 ETH，覆盖所有可能的费率，从 1 到 50 个基点。这不是偶然，也不是错误——这是策略。有人把流动性铺满了整个费率谱系，就像按花色摊牌，让每一步都有回应。第二组在 68 个区块后到来。另一个代币——0xdcf405...9ab8，另一个钩子——0xf9807122...d000。但同样的模式：五个池子，从 100 到 3000 个基点，按 tick 间距步进。唯一的区别是他们在三千点停下了——说明他们知道这对代币的流动性边界在哪里。有趣的是，第一个钩子合约——0x2c59f7...9000——服务了全部十一个池子。一个钩子撑起整条费率线。第二个——0xf98071...d000——只服务五个。要么第一个钩子更通用，要么第二对代币更挑剔。两个代币，两个钩子，一条链。没有人会无缘无故做这样的部署——显然有人在为流动性分发做准备，这些池子是桌上的第一批筹码。问题不是谁干的，而是他们知道什么别人不知道的事。

take.en: Builders are deploying pools with non-standard swap fees — either zero or the maximum tier — instead of the usual market rates, signaling deliberate economic design where revenue is taken through the hook rather than the swap.
take.zh: 建造者正在部署非标准兑换费的池子——要么零费率，要么最高档——而不是常见的市场费率，这表明他们有意通过钩子合约而不是兑换来获取收入，这不是一次普通的代币发行。

narrative.en: The evening of July 17th saw the same hook contract—0x96b8...fe0cc—run two identical deals with different tokens. Both pools at zero fee, tick spacing 200. First at block 25548686, second at 25548692. Six blocks apart. Someone clearly testing the mechanics on a couple of different assets, but with the same set of parameters. No liquidity, just initialization. Then the real fireworks hit at block 25548709. One token 0x00009de46ef19cc00580e4855a6e3e4d8bcd8e2c and one hook contract 0x1111...b9000. Ten pools. Ten fee tiers from 1 to 50 basis points. Each with its own tick spacing—from 1 to 1000. Someone fanned the deck. Every possible configuration for one pair. No doubt—this isn't chance, it's a measurement. Someone wanted to see how the router would behave when choosing among ten pools identical in tokens but different in fees. The hooks are likely just collecting statistics or emulating dynamic fees. 81 blocks later, another pattern. Same handwriting, different contract: 0xdf0a...1000. Three pools for token 0x3572...164c. Fees 100, 200, 500. Tick spacings 1, 2, 10. Again a series, again without liquidity. Someone methodically seeding the field. None of these pools have been touched—no swaps, no additions. Pure markup. What is this? Preparation for launching hooks with dynamic rules. Testing routing. Or just someone with a large gas budget deciding to see how many pools can be created in one block. The deck is being shuffled, but the cards haven't been dealt yet.
narrative.zh: 7月17日晚，同一个hooks合约——0x96b8...fe0cc——用两个不同的代币做了两笔一模一样的部署。两个池子都是零费率，tickSpacing 200。第一个在区块25548686，第二个在25548692，相隔六个区块。显然有人在用同一套参数测试不同资产上的机制。没有流动性，只是初始化。真正的烟花在区块25548709绽放。一个代币0x00009de46ef19cc00580e4855a6e3e4d8bcd8e2c和一个hooks合约0x1111...b9000。十个池子。十个从1到50基点的费率档位，每个对应不同的tickSpacing——从1到1000。有人把牌摊开了。同一对代币的所有可能配置。毫无疑问——这不是偶然，是一次测量。有人想看看路由器在面对十个代币相同但费率不同的池子时会如何选择。hooks很可能只是在收集统计数据或模拟动态费率。81个区块后，又一个模式。同样的笔迹，不同的合约：0xdf0a...1000。代币0x3572...164c的三个池子。费率100、200、500。tickSpacing 1、2、10。又是一系列部署，同样没有流动性。有人在有条不紊地播种。这些池子至今无人触碰——没有交换，没有添加。纯粹是标记。这是什么？为启动带动态规则的hooks做准备。测试路由。或者只是某个gas充裕的人想看看一个区块内能创建多少个池子。牌在洗，但还没发。

take.en: A single hook contract is deploying pools in rapid succession, far above the pace of typical deployers.
take.zh: 单个hooks合约正以远超典型部署者的速度连续部署池子。

narrative.en: Three pools on V4, same blockchain range, same hook contract: 0x0d62529346ac2c61f5c0582210d01214687bc0cc. This is not coincidence, it's a pattern. Someone is laying out a deck where the hook isn't just a modifier—it's the centerpiece of the deal. Zero fee, tickSpacing 200—classic setup for high-frequency or specialized liquidity. But with no fee, the pool doesn't live on the spread; it lives on something else. The hook can charge separately, redistribute, alter swap logic—it's a black box. Three pools with the same hook means a strategy is being tested across different pairs. ETH against three tokens, each a small, obscure address: 0xce5fd93f, 0x7d450533, 0x069f0862. None ring a bell. Fresh, likely recently deployed or unwrapped for this specific mechanic. Could be the same deployer stamping pools like cards of one suit. Or a bot auto-creating pairs for a certain hook scenario. Blocks 25540991, 25541114, 25541228—237 blocks between first and last. Not rushed, but rhythmic. No frenzy, just work. Someone is calmly building infrastructure. The question isn't what these tokens are. It's what that hook does. If it manipulates orders, emulates dynamic fees, or hides a liquidation mechanism—that's a new mechanic on the felt. For now, three silent pools. But silence in crypto is often the prelude to a loud hand.
narrative.zh: V4 上三个池子，同一条链，同一个 hook 合约：0x0d62529346ac2c61f5c0582210d01214687bc0cc。这不是巧合，这是布局。有人在摆牌局，hook 不是修饰符，而是牌局的轴心。零费率，tickSpacing 200——高频或特种流动性的经典配置。但没费率，池子不靠价差吃饭，那靠什么？hook 可以单独抽水、重新分配、改变兑换逻辑——这是个黑箱。三个池子用同一个 hook，说明在测试策略，不同对子。ETH 对三个小 token：0xce5fd93f、0x7d450533、0x069f0862，没一个眼熟。新面孔，可能是刚清算完或专为这套机制部署的。也许是同一个庄家在印池子，像印同花色的牌。或者是机器人自动创建对子，套某个 hook 剧本。区块 25540991、25541114、25541228——首尾差 237 个区块。不急不躁，但有节奏。没有喧嚣，只有干活。有人静静地在搭架子。问题不在这些 token 是什么，而在于那个 hook 做什么。如果它能操纵订单、模拟动态费率、或者藏了清算机关——那就是市场里的新招式。眼下只是三个沉默的池子。但在加密江湖，沉默往往是重头戏的前奏。

take.en: Someone is quietly laying down three identical hook-driven pools—this isn't random noise, it's a deliberate setup for a new play.
take.zh: 有人在悄悄布下三个同 hook 的池子——这不是杂音，是蓄谋的新局。

narrative.en: Four fresh deals hit the table last night — all hooks, all V4. The first pool at block 25534390 looked almost classic: two tokens, a fixed fee of 30 basis points, tick spacing of 60. The hook contract at 0xbbe88e sits there, but what it does is anyone's guess. No hook call logs at initialization, so the logic behind it stays face-down. Then came a tight run. Three pools in a row, all with zero fee, all with tick spacing 200 — that's no accident. The second and third pools share the same hook contract, 0x96b893, both with ether as the first token. Feels like someone is rolling out a family of pools under one mechanic — maybe dynamic fees, maybe some averaging strategy. Without a dump of hook events, you're just guessing. The fourth pool at block 25534595 uses a different hook, 0x0d6253. Also ether-based, also zero fee. Eight blocks between the third and fourth — someone worked fast, no pause to think. What sticks: none of these pools have any trade activity at the time of writing. They hang on the chain like blank cards. Hooks without calls are cards dealt but not yet flipped. Makes you wonder if any of these hands will see a first trade, or if they'll only live on as a line in the initialization logs. The V4 deck is growing, but it's a quiet growth. Without events from the hooks, you can't tell who's the ace and who's just filling the seat.
narrative.zh: 昨夜江湖又添四座新池，皆是V4门派，个个带钩。首池生于区块25534390，看似规矩：双币，固定手续费三十基点，步阶六十。钩子藏于0xbbe88e，却不知其用意——开池时无钩子日志，内功心法无从窥探。紧接着三池连出，皆零手续费，步阶二百，绝非巧合。第二、第三池共用一钩，契约0x96b893，皆以以太为基币。看来有人在布阵，同一钩法，或为动态收费，或为某种均值策略。无钩子事件可查，只能揣测。第四池在区块25534595，换了钩子，0x0d6253，仍是以太为基，零手续费。与第三池相隔八块，出手极快，毫无迟疑。引人注意的是，这些池至今无一笔交易。它们悬于链上，如白纸一张。钩子无调用，好比宝剑未出鞘。不知这些池中，谁能等到第一笔买卖，还是终将成为初始化日志里的一行记录。V4江湖在扩张，但只是暗流涌动。钩子不响，难辨谁是真正的高手，谁只是占个位置。

take.en: The house is dealing V4 pools with zero fees and idle hooks — no action yet, but the pattern says someone is building a system, not just flipping tokens.
take.zh: 庄家连开零费池，钩子未动，却已布下阵法——这不是散兵游勇，而是有人在搭台唱戏。

narrative.en: The dealer's hands are moving across the felt. Eleven of today's sixteen pool initializations trace back to a single contract, each one a fresh pair with zero swap fee, tick spacing of 200, and tokens bearing the 0x69 prefix—serial numbers on disposable cards. All pairs use raw ETH, no WETH, no stablecoins. The addresses appear in clusters: first a trio, then a gap, then five more across forty-six blocks. Someone sat on prepared transactions, releasing them when gas dropped. This is not randomness; it's a deliberate setup, a deck being stacked.
narrative.zh: 江湖上今天有异动。十六个新池子里，十一个出自同一门派，手续费全免，tick间距都是200，代币前缀清一色0x69——像是同一批铸出的暗器。这些池子只接纯ETH，不要WETH，也不要USDC、USDT。时间上看，先是三个同区块出现，沉默一阵，又在四十六个区块内连出五个。有人在等gas低的时候分批撒网，不是散兵游勇，是蓄谋已久的布阵。

take.en: Eleven identical zero-fee pools from one factory signal a coordinated play, not organic activity—the house is preparing a liquidity trap or a hook-based revenue scheme.
take.zh: 十一个零手续费池子同出一源，不是散户行为，是有人在搭台子——要么引君入瓮，要么靠钩子抽水。
